Historical Lower Creek (Muscogee) town

Coweta

Coweta was a Lower Creek town. National Park Service histories record Coweta people moving to the Ocmulgee River in the late seventeenth century and describe a Coweta Town on that river.

Where to start

The Ocmulgee River Corridor report follows Coweta between river settings. A separate ethnographic study includes Odette Freeman’s account of how her family passed down their connection to Coweta.
